metadata.case_name: YEUNG SHAN YEE SANDY v. SINGWAY (B.V.I.) CO LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Lacerations over the forehead and nasal area
source: physical examination revealed that there were lacerations over the forehead and the nasal area and bruises over the nasal bridge.
X-ray of the nasal bone showed depressed nasal bone fracture.

injuries.description: Deviated nasal septum to the left
source: The nasal septum was deviated to the left side opposite the middle turbinate.

injuries.description: Scarring over forehead and nasal bridge (5 cm inconspicuous transverse scar over her forehead; scars on her forehead and nasal bridge)
source: there was a 5 cm inconspicuous transverse scar over her forehead.
The Plaintiff showed to the court the scars on her forehead and nasal bridge, which are now rather inconspicuous.

injuries.description: Hypertrophy of inferior nasal turbinates (enlarged inferior nasal turbinates)
source: The inferior nasal turbinates were hypertrophic and enlarged.

manifestations.description: 5 cm inconspicuous transverse scar over her forehead
nasal bridge slightly depressed on the left side
lacerations and bruises over the nasal bridge

treatments_received: closed reduction of fractured nasal bone under local anesthesia
hospital admission (Accident and Emergency then transferred to Neurosurgery Department)
follow-up consultations and treatment at PYNEH Specialist Out-patient Department
laser cosmetic treatment to improve scars
treatments_future: septoplasty and nasal turbinectomy (cost about HK$25,000.00)

losses.description: The scars were very red, uneven, swollen and bruise. She had to cover her head with a cap often. She felt the scars very ugly, she thought people were looking at her scars and she hid herself at home for the first half year. She was desperate.
She hid herself at home for the first half year and was desperate following the cosmetic injuries.
